references.text: The disciples ask who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven, which mirrors their discussion about greatness in Mark 9:34.
Similar to the discussion among Jesus' disciples about who is the greatest, which also occurs in Mark 9:34.
The mother of James and John asks for a special position for her sons, reflecting the disciples' concern for rank as seen in Mark 9:34.
Jesus teaches that whoever wants to be the greatest among you must be your servant, addressing the theme of being the greatest as in Mark 9:34.
